h: Court orders El-Rufai to open his defence in the DSS phone-interception case
p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has rejected former Kaduna governor Nasir El-Rufai's no-case submission in the case brought by the DSS over his television remarks about intercepted calls. He must now present his defence.
more: He was granted N100 million bail in May.
His lawyers argue the prosecution has not shown enough evidence for him to defend himself.
